abstract: Can a multi-layer causal Transformer be trained without a backward pass—executing zero reverse pullbacks, zero VJP helpers, and zero same-step relays inside `with torch.no_grad():`—while improving speed and short-horizon accuracy over matched-subset node-perturbation comparators? We study a 3-stage delayed Weight Maximization (WM) pipeline across 97 backward-free multi-seed arms (`exp26`–`exp46`, plus 7 local-pullback and 13 exact-backpropagation references; $117$ arms $=350$ runs) on development-only `DEV`/`VAL-B` splits of ClimbMix `d6` ($L=6,D\in\{256..768\}$, $360$–$720$ steps) and Native `50.3M` ($L=8,D=512,T=2,048$, $100$ steps). We analyze stream-partitioned WM for separable channels and `RMSNorm` interfaces (Proposition 1), commute $W_v$ with causal attention during the forward pass to lift single-step `attn.c_v` cosine alignment $8.2\times$ ($+0.1104\to+0.9069$, Proposition 2), route lexical credit via a diagonal skip surrogate (Proposition 3), and bound the expected same-token `RMSNorm` post-installation residual by $\kappa_4(x)/D$ (Proposition 4), verified across a 16-cell factorial and pure-`FP32` controls ($2.1359$ vs. $2.1579$ BPB). Fused register-tiled Triton kernels cut the 13-matrix `d6` WM suite $38.4\times$ ($134.31\to3.50$ ms/step) and `fwd+rule` step time $8.33\times$ ($155.6\to18.68$ ms/step). Co-designed `Pre-Polar Muon`, embedding velocity, and drift annealing reach $2.0682\pm0.0006$ `DEV` BPB on 4-matrix `d6` (vs. $2.0532$ 4-matrix Backpropagation, $2.2603$ $K=16$ `SR-LNP`, $2.2415$ 76-draw `SR-NP`), and Spherical Active-$W_Q$ (`exp45`, $W_K$ frozen) reaches $2.0641\pm0.0006$ ($2.0649\pm0.0006$ un-retracted; $2.0672\pm0.0006$ future-accumulated $W_K$). On Native `50.3M`, isolated Triton substitution cuts steady-state `fwd+rule` time $1.44\times$ (`exp32`) and $6.33\times$ ($M_g=1$, `exp43`), reaching $1.8978\pm0.0007$ `DEV` BPB on 4 matrices ($20.65$ GiB GPU-resident; $9.61$–$9.69$ GiB pinned-ring) and **$1.8897\pm0.0008$ `DEV` BPB ($1.8765\pm0.0013$ `VAL-B`, $203.72$ PPL) in $9.80$ GiB VRAM** with Spherical Active-$W_Q$ (`exp46`, $95.8\%$ active), trailing 6-matrix $1.6989$ backpropagation.
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: 1. Resolved all three clarifications from the v3 acceptance review (udVdPSYPrKma2P06) and all estimator/evaluation diagnostics from review CGi77uMGzI_uoyOZ: (a) Retained full per-iteration/per-step timing arrays, standard deviations, and sample sizes in benchmark_native50m_isolated_kernel.json (giving 1.60x steady-state rule and 1.44x steady-state fwd+rule speedup in exp32 CPU-offload, or 1.50x rule and 1.35x fwd+rule across all 5 steps 0-4 while reducing peak VRAM from 9.108 to 7.629 GiB; and 6.86x contraction / 1.67x fwd+rule speedup at M_g=8 and 29.54x contraction / 6.33x fwd+rule speedup at M_g=1 in exp43 GPU-resident); (b) Completed Section 4.8's precision disclosure (exp32 FP32 SDPA + forward traces vs. exp43 BF16 SDPA + deferred Stage-1 filtered input reconstruction) and descriptive framing of exp44 controls (scale_factor = 8.0 scoring 1.9350 +- 0.0003 vs. 1.9358 +- 0.0002 at scale_factor = 1.0, and eps = 1e-4 scoring 1.9266 +- 0.0004 vs. 1.8978 +- 0.0007 at eps = 1e-8 in 9.61-9.69 GiB peak VRAM); (c) Explicitly qualified run_attention_subspace_cosine_diagnostic as supplying oracle downstream gy_attn from loss.backward() at initialized seed=46 to isolate within-block attention transport (distinguishing Tier-1 W_V conditional reconstruction cos = 1.0000 from Table 1's +0.9069 end-to-end delayed cosine). 2. Resolved Key-Projection Same-Position Truncation vs. Temporally Complete Future-Query Accumulation, Per-Head Temperature Validation Parity, and Factorized Spherical Active-W_Q Attribution in run_exp45_d6_attn_routing_probe.py (exp45_d6_attn_routing_results.json) & verify_paper5.py: (i) proved and verified on a 2-token exact Rademacher enumeration that same-position key correlation captures only diagonal J_{ss}^T g_s, whereas accumulating future query rewards sum_{tau >= s} gamma_K^{tau - s} R_{head,tau} eliminates truncation bias at gamma_K = 1 and lifts K=64 key cosine 2.51x to 0.1340 (gamma_K=1.00) and 2.93x to 0.1565 (gamma_K=0.98) while K=1 remains limited by cross-time key superposition variance (0.0089), improving 3-seed d6 active-W_K from 2.0684 +- 0.0005 (same-pos) to 2.0672 +- 0.0006 DEV BPB (gamma_K=0.98); (ii) bound block.attn.head_log_temp to CausalSelfAttention so evaluate_bpb_disjoint evaluates learned temperatures (2.0681 +- 0.0006 DEV BPB); and (iii) added a 3-seed factorized Euclidean active-W_Q control at matched beta_Q=0.95, eta_Q=0.048 (2.0649 +- 0.0006 vs. 2.0641 +- 0.0006 for Spherical Active-W_Q, isolating -0.0033 BPB from step-size/momentum matching and -0.0008 BPB from spherical retraction + tangent projection). 3. Added 3-seed Native 50.3M Spherical Active-W_Q scale-transfer in run_exp46_native50m_active_q.py (exp46_native50m_active_q_results.json, bringing the total to 117 arms = 350 runs), achieving 1.8889 / 1.8897 / 1.8905 -> 1.8897 +- 0.0008 DEV BPB (1.8765 +- 0.0013 VAL-B BPB, 203.72 PPL) in 9.80 GiB peak VRAM across 48.23M / 50.33M (95.8%) active parameters (-0.0081 BPB / -4.67 PPL better than exp43 1.8978 +- 0.0007 and -0.0464 BPB / -28.42 PPL better than exp32 1.9361 +- 0.0004).
title: Three-Stage Delayed Eligibility-Trace Weight Maximization for Backward-Free Transformer Pretraining: Stream Partitioning, Forward Attention-Filtered Value Traces, Fused Triton Kernels, and Co-Designed Optimization
